title: Ask for more
story: Your AlphaFold job needs {{gpus}} GPUs and {{mem}} GB of memory. Start an interactive session with exactly that.

tasks.text: Start an interactive job with {{gpus}} GPUs and {{mem}}G memory

hints: `--gres=gpu:N` sets GPUs and `--mem=NG` sets memory: `srun --gres=gpu:{{gpus}} --mem={{mem}}G --pty bash`.
